We shop every day at the piazza Vittorio market, use only meat from Lazio farms, and keep about twenty dishes on the menu, not one more.

Teniamo poche bottiglie per etichetta e: We keep few bottles per label and buy straight from the growers, nearly all less than an hour from here. From outside the region only what we really need: a mountain red or two, a Verdicchio, the sparkling wines.

Come si prenota un tavolo?: How do I book a table?
. Rispondiamo tutti i giorni dalle 10 al: . We answer every day from 10 am to 11 pm. For the same evening, a phone call is better.
Da martedì a sabato 12:30–15:00 e 19:00–: Tuesday to Saturday 12.30–3 pm and 7–11.30 pm. Sunday lunch only, 12.30–4 pm. Closed Monday, the day for the market and for rest.
Come si arriva da Termini?: How do I get here from Termini?
Siamo in Via Principe Amedeo 126, quattr: We are at Via Principe Amedeo 126, four minutes on foot from the Via Giovanni Giolitti exit. Metro A and B, Termini stop; metro A, Vittorio Emanuele stop; buses 105 and 360.
Avete piatti senza glutine, vegetariani: Do you have gluten-free, vegetarian or vegan dishes?
Sì. La pasta senza glutine la cuociamo i: Yes. Gluten-free pasta is cooked in a dedicated pot with dedicated tools: please tell us when you book. There are always at least three vegetarian and two vegan dishes on the menu — the puntarelle and the artichokes above all. The allergen list is available in the dining room.
Accettate gruppi e tavolate?: Do you take groups and large tables?
Fino a quattordici persone con menu conc: Up to fourteen people with a menu agreed in advance. To take the whole room — forty-two covers — write to us at least three weeks ahead: we will prepare something made to measure.
Volentieri, in sala e al dehors. Ciotola: Gladly, in the dining room and on the terrace. Bowl and water are on us.
Nel parcheggio interrato di piazza Vitto: In the underground car park at piazza Vittorio Emanuele II, 400 metres away, open until midnight. The restricted traffic zone is only active in some evening bands at weekends: ask us to confirm when you book.
Fate asporto o consegna?: Do you do takeaway or delivery?
Asporto sì, con ordine su WhatsApp entro: Takeaway yes, ordered on WhatsApp by 6 pm for dinner. Home delivery no: some dishes do not survive the journey, and we would rather not serve them badly.
